In Japan, Curves Japan, Inc. provides management guidance, systems, know-how, equipment, and products to franchisees; overseas, Curves International, Inc. manages royalties and sells equipment and other items to master franchisees in countries around the world. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥14,485 million.
entries.14f336e8e3e3ec0c: The company aims to grow as 'community-based health infrastructure' that contributes to extending healthy life expectancy. In the medium-term vision announced with its full-year results for the fiscal year ended August 2025, it sets as commitment targets 2,600 stores and 1.2 million members for the fiscal year ending August 2030. As near-term issues, it cites improving customer satisfaction, expanding its member base through stronger marketing, expanding product development and merchandise sales, and expanding its store network, including Men's Curves and Pinto Up.

entries.3dbe69b7424dfd33: In the fiscal year ended August 2025, the number of members rose from 817,000 at the end of the previous fiscal year to 863,000, and the number of domestic stores reached 1,996. The MD&A explains that new memberships increased due to three new-member recruitment campaigns a year, advertising centered on television and the web, and word-of-mouth and community-based initiatives, and that member merchandise sales reached a record high.
